title: Predictive Biases in Natural Language Processing Models: A Conceptual Framework and Overview

bias_targets.methodology: Formalizing outcome disparity and error disparity metrics (e.g., log-likelihood ratio) and reviewing methods such as counterfactual pronoun substitution, masked word probability differences in embeddings, and distribution matching in coreference resolution and image captioning.

Reviewing error disparities in hate speech detection models and evaluating semantic bias and overamplification through counterfactual substitution of racially associated names in sentiment analysis tasks.

Analyzing error disparities in NLP tasks like Part-of-Speech (POS) tagging across different age groups, and reviewing confounding demographic correlations in mental health differential diagnosis (e.g., PTSD vs. depression).

Evaluating selection bias and error disparities by measuring the performance degradation of syntactic tools (like POS taggers and parsers) when applied to minority dialects or sociolinguistic varieties like African-American Vernacular English (AAVE).
